metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on December 8, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to identify islands (land surrounded by water) within 2 km of the given point (27.245974°N, 140.878144°E) on December 8, 2013. This location is in the Pacific Ocean near Japan (Ogasawara Islands region). I'll use Sentinel-2 or Landsat data to detect land/water boundaries. 2. Date consideration: December 8, 2013 - Sentinel-2 wasn't launched until 2015, so I must use Landsat 8 (launched Feb 2013) or Landsat 7. 3. Masking strategy: Need to classify land vs water, not mask clouds initially but need to check for cloud-free images. Use NDWI or similar water index to separate land from water. 4. Logic: - Create 2km buffer around point - Get cloud-free imagery from Dec 8, 2013 (±few days if needed) - Classify land/water using NDWI or NIR/SWIR bands - Use connectedPixelCount to identify distinct land masses - Count isolated islands (land patches completely surrounded by water) - If exactly 2 islands found -> A, otherwise -> B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([140.878144, 27.245974]); const buffer = point.buffer(2000); // 2 km radius const targetDate = '2013-12-08'; const dateStart = '2013-12-01'; const dateEnd = '2013-12-15'; console.log('Analyzing location: (27.245974, 140.878144)'); console.log('Date: December 8, 2013, Buffer: 2 km'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8 first, then Landsat 7 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); let size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat 8 images found:', size); if (size === 0) { // Try Landsat 7 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat 7 images found:', size); if (size === 0) { console.log('No images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Get best image (least cloudy, closest to target date) const image = collection.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); // For Landsat 8: NIR=SR_B5, SWIR1=SR_B6 // For Landsat 7: NIR=SR_B4, SWIR1=SR_B5 const nir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B6').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); // Calculate NDWI (water index: (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR)) const ndwi = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)).rename('ndwi'); // Classify: water (NDWI > 0), land (NDWI <= 0) const land = ndwi.lt(0).selfMask().clip(buffer); // 4. Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = await land.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ndwi').getInfo(); console.log('Valid land pixels:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log('No land pixels detected in buffer.'); console.log('B'); return; } // 5. Identify connected land masses (islands) const connected = land.connectedPixelCount(256, false); const islands = connected.gt(10); // Minimum 10 pixels to be considered an island // Label each distinct island const labeled = islands.connectedComponents({ connectedness: ee.Kernel.square(1), maxSize: 256 }); // 6. Count distinct islands const islandCount = await labeled.select('labels').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('labels').getInfo(); console.log('Number of distinct islands found:', islandCount); // 7. Final Answer if (islandCount === null || islandCount === undefined) { console.log('Island counting failed.'); console.log('C3'); } else if (islandCount === 2) { console.log('Exactly 2 isolated islands detected.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Not exactly 2 islands.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
